title: Umusi w'Iyerekanwa rya nyuma
intro: Bahamagawe kugira ngo berekane ububasha bwabo mu buryo buhambaye, umugwi w’abahinga mu vyo gukina, basanze bariko barahangana n’ukuri batari biteze kwohinduye ubuzima bwabo ibihe bidahera.
clues: Twari tuzwi cane kubera ubuhinga bwacu, turi abahinga mu vy’ukwihenda n’ubuhendanyi.
Twarahamagariwe n’umutware kugira ngo tuhangane n’umuntu yariko araduhangana yari afise inkoni yoroshe.
Twabonye ukuri, twaciye dupfukama, tumenyesha ukwizera Umukama w’isi.
Uwo munyagitugu yaraduteye ubwoba ko azoduhana bikomeye, mugabo ntitwacitse intege.
Twari mu ba mbere bemeye ubutumwa tumaze kubona ikimenyetso gitomoye.
Twaragandaguwe kubera ukwemera kwacu, ariko tuzoba aba mbere mu kwinjira mw’Iparadizo hamwe n’abagororotsi.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
